text:
ops-bot: [ALERT] schema-validator spike on /invoke v2 in eu-west1 — 78 rejects in last 10m. routing policy bumped 24 fallbacks to degen. sample payload captured.
kevin: I pulled a couple samples — looks like an array vs object mismatch. example: ```json\n{\n  \"tools\": [ { \"id\": \"gcal\", \"result\": \"ok\" } ]\n}\n``` spec expects `tool` (object) not `tools` (array).
maria: wait — did the stricter fncall canary go out yesterday? I toggled soft->strict for a tiny slice.
jamie: yep, canary 0.3 enabled stricter validator in the router layer. but SDKs varied between plural vs singular streaming payloads; looks like an incompat.
sasha: telemetry shows 85% of rejects from one client token (acct: acme-inc) using agent v1.2.0. they batch tool responses which produces arrays.
kevin: impact: router policy currently treats any schema-reject > threshold as degen fallback. that caused degen_route_count to spike and quota being double-billed.
maria: double-billing is bad. We should avoid falling back for trivial shape differences (pluralization/array-wrapping).
jamie: quick mitigation: add a lightweight heuristic classifier in router to label rejects as `shape_pluralization` if mismatch is only plural key or single-element array where object acceptable.
kevin: and tag metric with `schema_category=shape_pluralization` so console can filter.
sasha: also bump sampling for full-response capture: from 1% -> 10% for next 30m so we have raw payloads for debugging.
ops-bot: incident created INC-20260321-23 (P2) assigned to @maria, @jamie.
maria: I'll own rollout and sampling. plan: jamie opens PR for classifier + metric tag, I'll deploy to EU canary only in ~20m, bump sampling for 30m, monitor.
kevin: longer-term: change fallback gating to require >=3 independent reject events in rolling 5m window for degen fallback if category==shape_pluralization. Only allow immediate fallback for "semantic" missing-required-field rejects.
jamie: PR #4201 opened: https://git/repo/pulls/4201 — contains router classifier, new `schema_category` tag, and gate change to 3-reject threshold for shape-type categories. rolling to canary EU.
sasha: console request: add `reject_reason_breakdown` (percent) to routing dashboard, and a top-5 failure patterns widget. ops need context, not just raw counts.
maria: billing issue: current attribution charges both original route and degen route on fallback. kevin — can you file a billing dedupe ticket? we need to attribute fallback tokens to original route and emit `fallback_tag` for dedupe.
kevin: filing now. ticket BILL-20260321-7. also adding compatibility note in SDK changelog and upgrade flag for agent <1.3.
jamie: quick log snippet from a failing request for reference:
```\n{ \"request_id\": \"req-abc-123\", \"response\": { \"tools\": [{\"id\":\"gcal\",\"result\":\"ok\"}] }, \"validator\": \"expected object 'tool' but got array 'tools'\" }\n```
sasha: after canary, schedule 1h postmortem doc + decision doc for console UX. propose we expose a one-click 'ignore-shape-variants' toggle for routes that prefer lenient shaping.
maria: TL;DR action items: jamie -> PR and canary deploy; maria -> sampling bump + monitor; kevin -> billing dedupe ticket + SDK note; sasha -> dashboard widget spec. ETA: patch live canary in 20m, billing ETA tomorrow.
kevin: ack. :thumbsup:
